title: Longtail SLO meter and annotation adapter
author: Priya Nandakumar
release_notes: Adds a long-tail SLO meter that aggregates low-frequency failure modes into a decay-weighted signal, an annotation adapter to attach contextual evidence to flagged prompt-sets, and a CI soft-fail integration that converts sustained SLO deviation into an actionable Linear ticket.
description: Motivation: We have seen sporadic, low-volume prompt-set failures that escape per-run thresholds but aggregate into customer-visible issues over time (long tail). This PR implements a Longtail SLO Meter that maintains a decay-weighted time series of failure signals and a companion Annotation Adapter to attach contextual evidence (examples, model variant, env) to flagged prompt-sets. The goal is to surface gradual SLO drift earlier and enable actionable handoff to triage workflows without increasing noisy CI failures. Design summary: 1) longtail_meter module: computes an exponentially decayed aggregate for each prompt-cohort keyed by prompt_set_id + model_variant, supports configurable half-life and bucket lengths; 2) annotation_adapter: lightweight pluggable interface (sync+async) that writes structured evidence to eval metadata and an optional annotations store; 3) ci-integration: a CI soft-fail mode that transitions from local eval failure -> sustained longtail deviation -> automatic Linear ticket creation with pre-filled evidence. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is opt-in via eval config. No changes to existing eval schema unless the annotation_adapter is enabled. Config knobs: decay_half_life (minutes/hours/days), min_sample_threshold, sustained_window_count, alert_threshold. Testing: unit tests for aggregator math, integration tests with synthetic prompt-sets, end-to-end smoke run against nightly eval harness. Rollout plan: gated behind feature flag and gradual enabling for internal teams before rolling to public CI gating. Related work: ENG-4287 (slo instrumentation), ENG-4301 (annotation store RFC).

review_thread:
Diego Morales (reviewer): Can you explain how decay_half_life maps to bucket size? Priya: The half-life controls the exponential weight; bucket_size is orthogonal and controls aggregation granularity. We expose both knobs but recommend a default 24h half-life with 1h buckets. Diego: Add a short doc note with recommended defaults. ACTION taken.
Ava Chen: Concern about creating too many Linear tickets from noisy signals. Proposed: require sustained_window_count >= 3 and min_sample_threshold >= 50 by default. Priya: Implemented thresholding and added jitter suppression in the ci hook.
Samuel O'Neill: Suggests optimistic path for annotation_adapter: avoid blocking eval runs on remote adapter failures. Priya: added async background writer with bounded retry and local cache fallback.
Diego: Minor style nits and type hints requested. Priya: addressed in follow-up commit.
Final: approvals from Diego and Ava; Samuel gave comment + thumbs-up after background writer change.

Post-merge tasks: create onboarding doc for internal teams, add feature-flag auditing in the console, and schedule a cross-team demo. Linear ticket auto-creation path tested end-to-end with sandbox token and a dry-run mode enabled by default.
notes: Operational considerations: annotation storage is opt-in to avoid PII capture; adapter includes a redact hook. The longtail meter exposes Prometheus metrics (longtail_decay_value, longtail_samples_count, longtail_alerts_created) and tracing for sample ingestion. Future work: sampled evidence attachments to traces, adaptive half-life tuning based on traffic seasonality.
